WITH Employee_Seniority AS (
    SELECT 
        e.People_ID,
        SUM(e.Year_working) as total_years,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(e.Year_working) <= 2 THEN 'junior'
            WHEN SUM(e.Year_working) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'mid-level'
            ELSE 'senior'
        END as seniority_level
    FROM employment e
    GROUP BY e.People_ID
)
SELECT 
    es.seniority_level,
    AVG(c.Market_Value_in_Billion) as avg_market_value
FROM Employee_Seniority es
